content_of_post_to_comment: Let’s have some fun. Take a famous line from literature and add the word “bro.” “It is a truth universally acknowledged, that a single man in possession of a good fortune, must be in want of a wife, bro.”
comment: The funniest part is how “bro” shifts the social contract of the sentence. It turns Austen’s polished certainty into a casual conversation, which makes you notice how much literary voice depends on tone, not just words.
